authorization: Owner asked for three things end to end on 13 November 2026 ("let's do 1, 2, and 3 systematically end to end full send"): finish the 12 November incident, seed the most-read passages, and do tickets #60, #68 and #69 while parking the rest of the backlog.

Owner approved the release when asked, with the order and checks named: "Release and verify (Recommended)" (push Convex, set LNURL_PAY_URL in Convex, deploy Vercel, check an image quote, a zero-credit refusal and the invoice status view).
Owner approved a seeding trial when asked, with its size and budget named: "Trial of 20 first (Recommended)" (20 verses, $2).

release.reviewFindings: Sol reviewed each change (2, 2, 2, 3, 5 and 1 rounds). #420: a gateway error page was treated as a safe failure, and a rate-limited retry dropped the purchase intent; both could leave two invoices for one purchase. #421: a payment held by the node at expiry stopped the server from looking. #423: a retried request rode on an earlier acceptance at a higher price; chat charged from half a usage report; a catalog rate could move without the quote being refused; a capped charge undercounted the daily limit; a reported zero image cost was treated as missing. CodeRabbit on #423: an automatic image request could follow a click whose changed price was waiting for confirmation; the chat per-message limit applied to the estimate, not the maximum. All fixed before merge.

convex.environment: LNURL_PAY_URL set after the push, to the same pay server Next.js uses

deploy.order: Convex first, then Vercel, by hand. Vercel's Git integration is disconnected (docs/incidents/2026-11-12-injected-install-script.md).
deploy.betweenTheTwo: With the new Convex functions and the previous frontend, health was ok and a zero-credit guest's image request for John 1:1 was refused with 402, required 6.

smoke.purchaseIntent: Two POST /api/invoice requests with one intent id returned the same unpaid $1 invoice (1,468 sats, 100 credits). It was left unpaid.

reconciliation.after45Seconds: The new invoice is watched and the pay server answered Convex for it. Of the 12 never-checked invoices, the node answered for four (three moved from pending to expired, one was already expired); eight it could not look up, and those stop after eight tries. No historical invoice was reported settled and no credit was granted (22 paid before and after).

smoke.spend: none: no image or chat call was made in production
smoke.notExercised: A funded guest accepting an image quote and being charged, and a paid chat turn, in production. The chat path ran end to end against a local Convex backend before the merge (#423).

seedTrial.verses: John 1:1 to John 1:20, Classical; Genesis 1's 31 verses were skipped as already present
seedTrial.note: The first image renders in production after this release, made as the owner, who is not quoted or charged. The ledger is kept outside git (output/seed-images/visibible.com/ledger.ndjson); a later run continues at John 1:21 and counts this spend against its budget.
